verdict.rationale: This story asks whether the product can act as an MCP client or host that consumes external MCP servers' tools. Airwallex is a financial and payments platform, not an agent or assistant that hosts tool-using AI, so this client role is a category error for it. Its documented AgentOS MCP and Developer MCP make it an MCP server for other agents, which belongs to the separate server story and is not credited here.
